text: If you are looking for a mug tree that you .... If you are looking for a mug tree that you can actually hang SIX mugs on this is not the mug tree for you. It will only hold four mugs. The bottom two rungs are too close to the cabinet. Unless maybe it was meant for demitasse cups.

product_metadata.title: Home Basics Rooster Collection Mug Tree
features: Mug tree holds coffee mugs and teacups for easy access on counter
High quality steel wire with powder coated finish
description: Home Basics This mug tree stores and displays up to six of your favorite coffee mugs and teacups in a fashionable manner. Durable design to ensure stability. Ideal in kitchens for coffee and tea lovers. An essential piece of the rooster home collection.
